selection: Retrospective diagnostic development on the known KITTI01/02 failures. Existing fixed plane/elevation values selected on07;00 influenced prior diagnosis. No held-out or improvement claim.
cases: Every final or S2S bad-length step under inherited0.1m/20% labels, plus immediate neighbours. Also first step and every existing100step-block endpoint on all three sequences, including10 with no threshold event. Deduplicate. No hand-selected success subset.
intervention: For each same raw scan pair, use existing forced-pose diagnostics with a fresh two-scan object, mapping disabled to isolate S2S. Natural seed is the stored passive S2S input. previous_mapped is the previous accepted final-pose increment, reused as the constant-motion seed. Oracle is this pair GT increment and is diagnostic only, outside the paper; not deployable and not an odometry benchmark. Never combine forced and passive trace.
controls: Require natural replay output and first H/g/counts to agree with the complete natural trace before interpreting any alternate seed. S2S depends only on previous extracted/indexed scan; no map or trajectory is reconstructed. Source and target, feature extractor, residuals, gates, budget, damping and library binary are identical across modes.
params: Existing paper_odometry_plane_check fixed params, acceleratedfalse; only use_mappingfalse for the isolated pair diagnostic, identical in every mode. No estimator/default/runner API changes.
data: Official fetch_kitti_odometry_sequences.py, one full sequence at a time. Check all input hashes against committed natural-trace inputs before execution and deletion. Retain failures and stop on control mismatch; delete only owned scans after validated evidence is archived and committed.
report: Per-case seed/output local length/vector errors, output change, first systems by feature class, count and explicit unavailable values. Compare all selected bad and other moving cases with inherited criterion; no significance test or threshold fitting. Commit native outputs and actual commands/exits before numerical prose.
limits: Fixed-pair causal intervention on initialization only. It cannot establish full-trajectory benefit, actual correspondence identities, ground-truth correctness, or complete solver cause. GT oracle is not a proposed estimator. A mixed/negative result is retained. Any later candidate requires opt-in defaultoff and uniform full-sequence evaluation, separately from this study.
